dct_description_sm: This record covers single road maps of New York, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records. This collection includes single printed maps and may also include photocopies of printed or manuscript single maps, multi-sheet single maps, plates from atlases, books or periodicals, and printed facsimiles. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
